meta.name: Persona MVP v2 Design DNA
meta.description: Persona v2 design profile: original Persona palette and constellation logos combined with the current Geist typography and the structural design language adapted from the approved CRM reference.

color.palette_type: analogous indigo and violet-neutral palette with a restrained brand accent

primary.role: Persona brand color, primary action fill, selection, and logo core

secondary.role: violet-neutral dark surface and secondary structural layer

accent.role: dark-theme focus ring, visibility accent, and logo satellites; not a competing action color

neutral.usage: violet-tinted neutrals define surfaces, borders, secondary text, navigation, and dark-mode layers

surface.elevated: #F7F5FE light; #4F4866 dark with a subtle indigo ring or restrained shadow

color.contrast_strategy: dark violet-neutral on light surfaces and near-white on dark violet-neutral surfaces, with saturated indigo reserved for primary action, focus, selection, and brand marks

heading_3.tracking: tight on landing; normal in application

typography.font_style_notes: neutral neo-grotesk sans, medium-weight hierarchy, compact application text, and monospace reserved for labels, domains, dates, and technical metadata

spacing.content_density: compact and information-dense in the application; spacious in marketing sections
spacing.section_rhythm: 24px application page rhythm; 48px to 72px landing section internals; 80px to 120px landing section separation

layout.grid_system: responsive CSS grid and flex layouts with container-query-driven dashboard composition
layout.columns: 1 mobile, 2 medium, up to 4 dashboard columns; asymmetric 2:1 hero rows; mixed bento landing layout
layout.gutter: 16px mobile and 24px desktop page gutters; 16px card-grid gap
layout.alignment_tendency: strict grid in the application, centered editorial composition in the landing hero, and controlled asymmetric bento groups

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px neutral borders define controls, tables, panels, separators, and grouped data
shape.divider_style: flat 1px solid neutral divider, frequently edge-to-edge in lists and tables

levels.high: 0 8px 16px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08), with 16px/32px reserved for highest overlays

elevation.depth_cues: borders and neutral surface changes first, restrained shadows on floating controls, rings on overlays, and blur only behind modal overlays

iconography.style: clean outlined functional symbols with occasional solid brand marks
iconography.preferred_set: Carbon Icons for product actions, Lucide for utility states, and the official Persona constellation SVGs in apps/web/public/brand

motion.easing: ease-out for entry, ease-in for exit, ease-in-out for movement, with spring easing for async state swaps
motion.entrance_pattern: subtle fade, 95% scale-in, short slide, blur-to-sharp, or 12px rise
motion.exit_pattern: faster fade, scale-out, or directional slide
motion.philosophy: minimal functional motion with reduced-motion support and restrained playful icon feedback

components.button_style: compact 32px default height, 5px radius, small medium-weight label, primary indigo or neutral outline/ghost variants, and a very soft shadow
components.input_style: compact 32px height, violet-neutral 1px border, 5px radius, subtle hover border and lavender focus ring, with inset depth in dark mode
components.card_style: mostly flat grouped surfaces; 8px radius and neutral border when the card contains controls, borderless dark bento cards on the landing page
components.navigation_pattern: 48px application header plus 56px icon rail on desktop, compact horizontal alternatives on mobile, and a centered max-width landing navigation
components.modal_style: small centered popover surface with 8px radius, 1px ring, subtle shadow, dimmed backdrop, and 100ms fade/zoom
components.list_style: dense 44px or 48px rows with hairline separators, quiet hover fills, compact metadata, and tabular alignment
components.component_notes: shadcn/Radix primitives centralized in packages/ui; visual variants are defined at the shared component layer rather than at call sites

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: a disciplined operator console with editorial restraint
aesthetic.genre: professional narrative SaaS with minimalist editorial product design

visual_language.complexity: moderate information complexity expressed with minimal decoration
visual_language.whitespace_usage: functional and compact in workflows; generous and cinematic around landing-page statements
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: content and evidence carry most weight; Persona indigo is used sparingly to establish action priority and traceability
visual_language.focal_strategy: typographic hierarchy and selective filled actions, followed by progressive disclosure of structured data
visual_language.contrast_level: high text contrast with low-contrast structural layers
visual_language.texture_usage: none; surfaces are intentionally flat and untinted

composition.hierarchy_method: typographic scale, weight, muted text, borders, and spatial grouping
composition.balance_type: strict modular balance with selective asymmetric dashboard and bento splits
composition.flow_direction: top-to-bottom, left-to-right scanning, with centered landing hero entry
composition.grouping_strategy: shared surfaces, edge-to-edge dividers, compact rows, bento blocks, and container-query sections
composition.negative_space_role: separates concepts and protects hierarchy without turning application screens into sparse showcases

imagery.photo_treatment: rare; small natural user avatars with no decorative photo treatment
imagery.illustration_style: none; product UI demonstrations replace illustration
imagery.graphic_elements: brand marks, product screenshots, charts, status dots, icons, and restrained mono labels
imagery.pattern_usage: no decorative patterns; occasional dot matrices serve functional loading or status roles
imagery.image_shape: small circular avatars and large rounded product frames with controlled clipping

interaction_feel.hover_behavior: quiet neutral fill or border change, occasional underline drawing, and small icon transforms
interaction_feel.transition_personality: snappy and subtle, with smooth directional page changes
interaction_feel.loading_style: skeleton pulse, SVG spinner trace, shimmer text, and explicit pending-to-success/error state swaps
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: moderate in controls and state changes, low in static content

brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: direct imperative focused on setup, creation, and the next action
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: brief explanation plus one clear path forward

overview.fallback_strategy: honor prefers-reduced-motion, remove animated transforms and shimmer, and preserve static state clarity
overview.primary_technology: CSS animations and React View Transitions, with Motion for a few stateful microinteractions

background_effects.description: flat neutral backgrounds with no generative or animated scene

3d_elements.description: no 3D scene or rendered model is present

shader_effects.description: no GLSL or shader-driven distortion is present

text_effects.description: functional shimmer for active text states and several lightweight underline hover variants
text_effects.technology: Motion plus CSS gradients, pseudo-elements, and keyframes

params.effect_style: horizontal muted-to-background shimmer and restrained underline transforms

image_effects.description: product-shot compositions use clipped rounded frames and selective blurred dimming to direct attention
image_effects.technology: CSS overflow clipping, translucent overlays, and backdrop-filter

params.filter_pipeline: 3px to 4px backdrop blur on dimmed product-shot regions

params.blur_radius: approximately 4px on modal overlays and 3px to 4px in product-shot focus masks
params.transparency: 18% black light overlay; 55% black dark overlay and product-shot mask
params.border_treatment: no glass border; underlying dialogs use a subtle foreground ring

svg_animations.type: spinner stroke trace and icon transforms
svg_animations.description: inline SVG spinners rotate or animate stroke dash offset, while shared icons receive small hover motions

visual_effects.composite_notes: The visual-effects layer is intentionally subordinate to product clarity. React View Transitions combine short blur/fade/rise or directional slide sequences for navigation; Motion swaps async and skeleton states with opacity, scale, and blur springs; CSS provides status pulses, icon gestures, loading spinners, link underlines, and small bloom cues. No heavy rendering stack, particles, shaders, WebGL, or scroll-scrubbing system was found. Reduced-motion fallbacks are implemented for the principal animated patterns.
